basic_details.job_title: IIT Delhi Senior Project Scientist Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Centre for Applied Research in Electronics (CARE) at the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi needs one Sr. Project Scientist for the project "A Unified IOT Architecture and Development Framework for 5G/6G Applications", funded by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology and running up to 14 March 2027. The consolidated pay-slab is Rs. 60,750 to Rs. 79,260 per month plus HRA @ 27%, and applicants need a 1st class M.Tech/MS(R) in Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline with a valid GATE score. Indian nationals

how_to_apply: Download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the IRD website of IIT Delhi (ird.iitd.ac.in/rec).
Fill in the form with complete information on educational qualifications, indicating the percentage of marks/division, and details of work experience.
Write the advertisement number (IITD/IRD/312/2026) on the subject line of the e-mail.
Send the duly filled form by e-mail to Prof. Monika Aggarwal at [email protected].
Make sure the e-mail is sent by 17 November 2026, 5.00 p.m.
Duly filled Form No. IRD/REC-4 with educational qualifications (percentage of marks/division) and work experience details.
important_instructions: The post may be downgraded at the discretion of the Selection Committee if none of the candidates is found suitable for the post. Updates on short-listing and the online interview appear only at ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted; candidates not short-listed are not informed.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited only from Indian nationals. The notice prints the following requirements for the Sr. Project Scientist post: 1st class M.Tech/MS(R) in Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline. A valid GATE score, as required under the applicable JRF recruitment rules. Good programming skills in MATLAB and Python. Strong fundamentals in signal processing, linear algebra, and probability. A keen interest in quantum computing, quantum machine learning, and AI-based signal processing. A 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to SC/ST candidates. The age limit is not specified in the notice. For any eligibility-related clarification, candidates may contact Prof. Monika Aggarwal at [email protected] . Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Sr. Project Scientist gets a consolidated fellowship/pay-slab of Rs. 60,750 - 62,570 - 64,450 - 66,380 - 68,370 - 70,420 - 72,530 - 74,710 - 76,950 - 79,260 per month, plus HRA @ 27%. The appointment is on a contractual basis with consolidated pay. It is renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project, whichever is earlier; the project runs up to 14/03/2027. If a retired/superannuated government employee is selected, his/her salary will be fixed as per prevailing IRD norms.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Delhi Sr. Project Scientist (01)
content_sections.text: Documents named in the notice: Duly filled Form No. IRD/REC-4 with educational qualifications (percentage of marks/division) and work experience details.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: IIT Delhi reserves the right to fix higher criteria for short-listing eligible candidates from those satisfying the advertised qualification and the requirement of the project post. The names of short-listed candidates will be displayed at ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted along with the online interview details. Only short-listed candidates will be informed for the online interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026 under Advertisement No. IITD/IRD/312/2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 vacancy for the post of Sr. Project Scientist in the Centre for Applied Research in Electronics (CARE).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Delhi Sr. Project Scientist post?
faq.answer: The completed application must be submitted by e-mail by 17 November 2026, 5.00 p.m.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the IIT Delhi Sr. Project Scientist post?
faq.answer: A 1st class M.Tech/MS(R) in Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline, plus a valid GATE score as required under the applicable JRF recruitment rules, is needed, along with good programming skills in MATLAB and Python.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the IIT Delhi Sr. Project Scientist?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay-slab is Rs. 60,750 to Rs. 79,260 per month, in stages, plus HRA @ 27%.

faq.question: Q5. Is HRA paid on top of the pay for the IIT Delhi Sr. Project Scientist post?
faq.answer: Yes. HRA @ 27% is paid in addition to the consolidated pay-slab of Rs. 60,750 to Rs. 79,260 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the IIT Delhi Sr. Project Scientist post?
faq.answer: Download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from ird.iitd.ac.in/rec, fill it in, and e-mail it to [email protected] with the advertisement number on the subject line.

faq.question: Q7. What should be written in the e-mail subject line?
faq.answer: The advertisement number, IITD/IRD/312/2026, must be written on the subject line of the e-mail.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the IIT Delhi Sr. Project Scientist post?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates are short-listed, with IIT Delhi free to fix higher criteria, and only short-listed candidates are informed for an online interview; their names appear at ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted.

faq.question: Q9. Is the IIT Delhi Sr. Project Scientist post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is on a contractual basis with consolidated pay, renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project (up to 14 March 2027), whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any relaxation for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: Yes. A 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to SC/ST candidates.
